However, she just ignored the doubt and stuck to her goal. In October, she joined the Young Entrepreneurs Academy (YEA!), where some [44] businessmen teach students business skills. "I entered knowing nothing about business but [45] as a businessman," she recalled. YEA!, established in 2004, helps [46] students develop ideas, conduct research, learn from the seniors, and build their businesses. Program director Candy Troutman witnessed Meenah's growth, "She was quiet at first but [47] the organization in the end. It's totally beyond expectation."

Later, Meenah attended a competition where she [48] her program to investors, and they were in favor of it. She was entitled "the Local Star" and [49] to the semifinal in New York. "Though I didn't reach the final, meeting new people was invaluable," she said.

With the support of investors, Meenah [50] founded Bkrafts in April, selling over $150,000 worth of handmade products. She balances school and business, [51] her creations at youth markets. Her [52] inspires peers, proving that [53] is no barrier to success.

"Success is not just about winning any [54] awards in a race," Meenah shared. "It's about an experience of pursuing your passion by [55] social prejudice against success at a young age."

questions.explanation: 根据上下文语境，12岁的Meenah花时间做手工，并将其视为一种爱好。have a passion for是固定表达，意为“对……有极大的热情/热爱”，符合句意。
questions.supplement:
A(passion)：a) 语境句：She has a strong passion for classical music and practices piano every day. b) 固定搭配：have a passion for, pursue one's passion
B(point)：a) 语境句：I think you missed the point of my presentation. b) 固定搭配：make a point, to the point
C(reason)：a) 语境句：The main reason for his success is hard work. b) 固定搭配：for some reason, reason for
D(rule)：a) 语境句：You must strictly follow the rules of the library. b) 固定搭配：break the rule, as a rule

questions.explanation: 前文提到她是Bkrafts公司的CEO，此处指她希望将做手工的爱好（hobby）转化为自己的“事业（career）”。
questions.supplement:
A(habit)：a) 语境句：Reading before bed is a good habit for your mental health. b) 固定搭配：fall into a habit, form a habit
B(tradition)：a) 语境句：Eating dumplings is a long-standing tradition during the Spring Festival. b) 固定搭配：cultural tradition, by tradition
C(deal)：a) 语境句：We finally made a deal after hours of negotiation. b) 固定搭配：make a deal, a great deal of
D(career)：a) 语境句：He decided to pursue a career in medicine to help others. b) 固定搭配：pursue a career, career path

questions.explanation: 听到她的抱负后，周围很多人深表怀疑，认为这个年纪的孩子不可能“获得成功”。make it 为固定习语，意为“获得成功，做到”。
questions.supplement:
A(take)：a) 语境句：We need to take immediate action to protect the environment. b) 固定搭配：take action, take part in
B(get)：a) 语境句：It took her a long time to get over the failure. b) 固定搭配：get involved, get over
C(make)：a) 语境句：Despite all the difficulties, she finally made it to the top. b) 固定搭配：make it, make sense
D(grasp)：a) 语境句：It took me a while to grasp the meaning of this complex theory. b) 固定搭配：grasp the meaning, grasp an opportunity

questions.explanation: 她加入了一个青年企业家学院，在那里由“有经验的（experienced）”商人教授学生商业技能，符合常理。
questions.supplement:
A(determined)：a) 语境句：She is determined to finish the marathon despite her injury. b) 固定搭配：be determined to do, determined look
B(experienced)：a) 语境句：As an experienced teacher, he knows how to handle naughty kids. b) 固定搭配：experienced in, highly experienced
C(excited)：a) 语境句：The children were very excited about the upcoming field trip. b) 固定搭配：be excited about, excited voice
D(satisfied)：a) 语境句：The customer was completely satisfied with our service. b) 固定搭配：be satisfied with, feel satisfied

questions.explanation: 句中的 entered (进来) 与所填空构成动作的对比：进来时对商业一无所知，但“离开时（left）”已经成为了一名商人。
questions.supplement:
A(left)：a) 语境句：He left the company to start his own business. b) 固定搭配：leave for, leave behind
B(worked)：a) 语境句：They worked out a new plan to increase sales. b) 固定搭配：work out, work on
C(failed)：a) 语境句：He failed to pass the driving test on his first attempt. b) 固定搭配：fail to do, fail an exam
D(pretended)：a) 语境句：She pretended to be asleep when her mother came in. b) 固定搭配：pretend to be, pretend not to know

questions.explanation: 青年企业家学院帮助具有相似抱负或目标的青年，like-minded 意为“志同道合的”，修饰这些想创业的学生最贴切。
questions.supplement:
A(simple-minded)：a) 语境句：His simple-minded approach to the complex issue caused more problems. b) 固定搭配：simple-minded person, simple-minded approach
B(like-minded)：a) 语境句：She joined a club to meet like-minded people who also love photography. b) 固定搭配：like-minded friends, group of like-minded people
C(hard-headed)：a) 语境句：As a hard-headed businessman, he never lets emotions affect his decisions. b) 固定搭配：hard-headed businessman, hard-headed realism
D(hot-headed)：a) 语境句：The hot-headed young man often got into arguments with strangers. b) 固定搭配：hot-headed teenager, hot-headed behavior

questions.explanation: 前后句构成转折，一开始她很安静，但最终她的表现“使组织大为折服（blew away）”，这完全超乎了预料（beyond expectation）。
questions.supplement:
A(worked up)：a) 语境句：Don't get too worked up over such a small mistake. b) 固定搭配：get worked up, work up an appetite
B(let down)：a) 语境句：I promised to help him, and I won't let him down. b) 固定搭配：let somebody down, feel let down
C(pulled out)：a) 语境句：The company pulled out of the project due to financial problems. b) 固定搭配：pull out of, pull out a tooth
D(blew away)：a) 语境句：Her amazing singing performance completely blew the judges away. b) 固定搭配：blow away the competition, be blown away by

questions.explanation: 在比赛中，她向投资者“展示/介绍（presented）”她的项目，并且投资者很支持。present sth to sb 意为向某人展示某物。
questions.supplement:
A(adjusted)：a) 语境句：It took her a few months to adjust to the new working environment. b) 固定搭配：adjust to, adjust the volume
B(presented)：a) 语境句：The scientist presented his research findings to the committee. b) 固定搭配：present sth to sb, present an award
C(changed)：a) 语境句：The caterpillar eventually changed into a beautiful butterfly. b) 固定搭配：change one's mind, change into
D(devoted)：a) 语境句：He devoted his entire life to finding a cure for the disease. b) 固定搭配：devote oneself to, devoted friend

questions.explanation: 她被授予“地方之星”的称号，并“晋级（advanced）”到纽约的半决赛。advance to 表示“晋级到……，推进到……”。
questions.supplement:
A(belonged)：a) 语境句：The old house belonged to a wealthy merchant in the 19th century. b) 固定搭配：belong to
B(related)：a) 语境句：The increase in crime is closely related to the rising unemployment rate. b) 固定搭配：be related to, relate to
C(advanced)：a) 语境句：The local football team advanced to the national finals after a tough match. b) 固定搭配：advance to, advance in technology
D(contributed)：a) 语境句：Regular exercise contributed to her quick recovery from illness. b) 固定搭配：contribute to, make a contribution

questions.explanation: 在经历了一系列学习、比赛并获得投资者支持后，Meenah“最终（eventually）”在四月份创立了Bkrafts。
questions.supplement:
A(eventually)：a) 语境句：After wandering in the forest for hours, they eventually found their way out. b) 固定搭配：eventually succeed, eventually become
B(randomly)：a) 语境句：The computer program randomly selects a winner from the participants. b) 固定搭配：choose randomly, randomly selected
C(potentially)：a) 语境句：This new chemical is potentially harmful to human health. b) 固定搭配：potentially dangerous, potentially harmful
D(temporarily)：a) 语境句：The bridge is temporarily closed for repairs. b) 固定搭配：temporarily closed, temporarily unavailable

questions.explanation: 她在学校和生意之间保持平衡，并在青年市场“推销（promoting）”她的手工作品。
questions.supplement:
A(purchasing)：a) 语境句：The company is considering purchasing a new office building. b) 固定搭配：purchase a house, purchasing power
B(promoting)：a) 语境句：The superstar is busy promoting his new movie across the country. b) 固定搭配：promote sales, promote a product
C(publishing)：a) 语境句：The author is preparing for publishing his third novel next month. b) 固定搭配：publish a book, newly published
D(maintaining)：a) 语境句：It's important to keep maintaining a balanced diet for good health. b) 固定搭配：maintain balance, maintain good relationships

questions.explanation: 前文提到她制作手工头带和手镯，这属于创意类工作，因此是她的“创造力（creativity）”或创业精神激励了同龄人。在给定的选项中，creativity最贴合“handmade creations”这一线索。
questions.supplement:
A(generosity)：a) 语境句：He was praised for his generosity after donating millions to charity. b) 固定搭配：show generosity, out of generosity
B(dependence)：a) 语境句：The country is trying to reduce its dependence on imported oil. b) 固定搭配：dependence on, financial dependence
C(kindness)：a) 语境句：A simple act of kindness can brighten someone's entire day. b) 固定搭配：act of kindness, out of kindness
D(creativity)：a) 语境句：This art project allows students to express their creativity freely. b) 固定搭配：show creativity, spark creativity

questions.explanation: 结合文章第一句“12岁”以及下文的“at a young age”，她的成功证明了“年龄（age）”不是成功的障碍。
questions.supplement:
A(gender)：a) 语境句：We should promote gender equality in the workplace. b) 固定搭配：gender equality, gender difference
B(ability)：a) 语境句：He has the ability to remain calm in emergency situations. b) 固定搭配：have the ability to, to the best of one's ability
C(age)：a) 语境句：He started learning to play the violin at the age of five. b) 固定搭配：at the age of, under age
D(poverty)：a) 语境句：Millions of people around the world are still living in extreme poverty. b) 固定搭配：live in poverty, extreme poverty

questions.explanation: 句意为：成功不仅仅是在比赛中赢得任何“物质（material）”奖励。这里将物质奖励与后半句中追逐热情的内在体验（experience）相对比。
questions.supplement:
A(virtual)：a) 语境句：The museum offers a virtual tour for visitors who cannot travel there. b) 固定搭配：virtual reality, virtual world
B(artistic)：a) 语境句：Her artistic talent was evident in the beautiful paintings she created. b) 固定搭配：artistic talent, artistic value
C(material)：a) 语境句：They believe that happiness is more important than material wealth. b) 固定搭配：material wealth, material comfort
D(moral)：a) 语境句：Parents play a crucial role in the moral development of their children. b) 固定搭配：moral standard, moral support

questions.explanation: 成功是关于追求你的热情，并通过“挑战（challenging）”社会对年轻成功的偏见来获得一种体验。challenge prejudice 意为挑战偏见。
questions.supplement:
A(challenging)：a) 语境句：By challenging traditional views, the young scientist made a breakthrough. b) 固定搭配：challenge oneself, face a challenge
B(measuring)：a) 语境句：He spent the morning measuring the dimensions of the room. b) 固定搭配：measure the distance, measuring tape
C(improving)：a) 语境句：She listens to English podcasts every day for improving her listening skills. b) 固定搭配：improve one's English, leave room for improvement
D(recording)：a) 语境句：The security camera was recording everything that happened in the store. b) 固定搭配：keep a record, record a video

vocab_pack.definition_en: to use time to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 spent 为过去式，表示过去花费时间做某事，后接动名词 building，构成 spend time doing 结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: She spends her time reading books every evening.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她每晚都花时间读书。
vocab_pack.from_passage: spent her time building a business

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a strong interest or enthusiasm for something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 对……有强烈的热爱或热情
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 have 为一般现在时，主语 I 使用原形，后接名词/动名词 crafting，表示对某事有热情。
vocab_pack.example_en: He has a passion for painting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他对绘画充满热情。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I have a passion for crafting (手工制作)

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: turn her hobby into a career
vocab_pack.definition_en: to change or develop into something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 turn 为不定式（want to do），后接宾语 her hobby 和介词短语 into a career，表示将爱好转变为职业。
vocab_pack.example_en: She turned her small idea into a successful company.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她把自己的小想法变成了一家成功的公司。
vocab_pack.from_passage: wanted to turn her hobby into a career

vocab_pack.definition_en: to succeed in achieving something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 make it 是固定搭配，用于 could 后表能力，否定式 couldn't 表示无法成功。
vocab_pack.example_en: With hard work, you can make it in the entertainment industry.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 通过努力工作，你可以在娱乐行业取得成功。
vocab_pack.from_passage: couldn't make it

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue doing something without changing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 stuck 为过去式，后接介词 to 和宾语 her goal，表示坚持目标。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should stick to your plan no matter what.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 无论发生什么，你都应该坚持你的计划。
vocab_pack.from_passage: stuck to her goal

vocab_pack.definition_en: to set up or create something (e.g., an organization)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 established 为过去分词，作后置定语修饰 YEA!，表示该学院成立于2004年，表被动含义。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school was established in 1990.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这所学校成立于1990年。
vocab_pack.from_passage: YEA!, established in 2004

vocab_pack.definition_en: having similar interests, opinions, or goals
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 志趣相投的，想法相同的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 like-minded 为复合形容词，修饰 students，表示志同道合的学生。
vocab_pack.example_en: She found like-minded friends at the art club.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在艺术俱乐部找到了志同道合的朋友。
vocab_pack.from_passage: like-minded students

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have no knowledge of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 knowing nothing about 为现在分词短语作伴随状语，表示进入时对商业毫无了解。
vocab_pack.example_en: He knew nothing about cooking before he moved out.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他搬出去住之前对烹饪一无所知。
vocab_pack.from_passage: knowing nothing about business

vocab_pack.definition_en: to create or improve ideas
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 develop 为动词原形，与 help 连用（help sb do），表示帮助学生们构思想法。
vocab_pack.example_en: The workshop helps students develop ideas for their projects.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个工作坊帮助学生们为他们的项目构思想法。
vocab_pack.from_passage: helps like-minded students develop ideas

vocab_pack.definition_en: to carry out academic or systematic investigation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 conduct 为动词原形（help sb do 结构），表示进行市场/商业研究。
vocab_pack.example_en: Scientists conduct research to find new cures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 科学家进行研究以找到新的治疗方法。
vocab_pack.from_passage: conduct research

vocab_pack.definition_en: to gain knowledge or experience from someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 learn from 为动词原形（help sb do 结构），后接 the seniors，表示向前辈学习。
vocab_pack.example_en: You can learn from your mistakes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你可以从错误中学习。
vocab_pack.from_passage: learn from the seniors

vocab_pack.definition_en: to see or observe someone's development or progress
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 witnessed 为过去式，后接名词短语 Meenah's growth，表示目睹了米娜的成长。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher witnessed her students' remarkable growth over the year.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师见证了学生们一年来的显著成长。
vocab_pack.from_passage: witnessed Meenah's growth

vocab_pack.definition_en: to impress someone greatly; to amaze
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 给……留下深刻印象，使惊艳
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 blew 为过去式，后接 the organization，表示让整个组织惊叹，是口语化表达。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her performance blew away the judges.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的表演让评委们惊叹不已。
vocab_pack.from_passage: blew away the organization

vocab_pack.definition_en: more than what was expected; surprisingly good
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 beyond expectation 为介词短语作表语，与 be 动词搭配（was beyond expectation），表示结果出乎意料。
vocab_pack.example_en: The outcome of the experiment was beyond expectation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 实验的结果超出了预期。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It's totally beyond expectation.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be present at or take part in a competition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 attended 为过去式，后接 a competition，表示参加了一次比赛。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many athletes attend the Olympic competition.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多运动员参加奥林匹克竞赛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: attended a competition

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show or introduce something to an audience
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 presented 为过去式，后接双宾语（ her program to investors），表示向投资者展示她的项目。
vocab_pack.example_en: She presented her research findings to the committee.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她向委员会展示了她的研究发现。
vocab_pack.from_passage: presented her program to investors

vocab_pack.definition_en: to support or approve of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 were 为 be 的过去式复数形式，与 in favor of 构成系表结构，表示投资者支持她的项目。
vocab_pack.example_en: The majority of the board members are in favor of the proposal.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大多数董事会成员都支持这项提议。
vocab_pack.from_passage: they were in favor of it

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be given a particular title or right
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 was entitled 为被动语态，过去时，后接 'the Local Star'，表示她被授予了“本地之星”的称号。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was entitled 'Employee of the Year'.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她被授予“年度员工”称号。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was entitled 'the Local Star'

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move forward to a next stage or level
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 advanced 为过去式，后接介词 to 和 the semifinal，表示晋级到半决赛。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team advanced to the finals after winning the semi-final.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 赢得半决赛后，该队晋级了决赛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: advanced to the semifinal

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely useful; priceless
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 invaluable 为形容词作表语，与 was 连用，描述结识新人的经历是无价的。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her advice was invaluable to my career.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的建议对我的职业生涯来说是无价的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: meeting new people was invaluable

vocab_pack.definition_en: with the help or backing of someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 With the support of 为介词短语作状语，位于句首，表示在投资者的支持下。
vocab_pack.example_en: With the support of her family, she overcame many difficulties.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在家人的支持下，她克服了许多困难。
vocab_pack.from_passage: With the support of investors

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start or establish an organization or company
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 founded 为过去式，后接 Bkrafts，表示最终创立了 Bkrafts 公司。
vocab_pack.example_en: He founded a nonprofit organization to help the poor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他创立了一个非营利组织来帮助穷人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: founded Bkrafts

vocab_pack.definition_en: an amount of something having a certain value
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 worth of 与金额 $150,000 连用，构成短语 over $150,000 worth of handmade products，表示总价值超过15万美元的手工产品。
vocab_pack.example_en: She bought $100 worth of books.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她买了价值100美元的书。
vocab_pack.from_passage: selling over $150,000 worth of handmade products

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give equal attention to two or more activities
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 balances 为一般现在时，主语第三人称单数加 s，后接 school and business，表示平衡学业和生意。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is important to balance work and family life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 平衡工作和家庭生活很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: balances school and business

vocab_pack.definition_en: to advertise or help sell products one has made
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 promoting 为现在分词作伴随状语，表示她通过在青年市场推广她的作品来平衡学业与生意。
vocab_pack.example_en: She promotes her handmade crafts on social media.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在社交媒体上推广她的手工作品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: promoting her creations at youth markets

vocab_pack.definition_en: to encourage or motivate people of the same age or status
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 inspiring 为现在分词作结果状语，表示她的创造力激励了同龄人，证明了年龄不是障碍。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her speech inspired many young people to chase their dreams.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的演讲激励了许多年轻人去追逐梦想。
vocab_pack.from_passage: inspiring peers

vocab_pack.definition_en: to not be an obstacle preventing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 is 为一般现在时单数形式，后接 no barrier to success，表示年龄不是成功的障碍。
vocab_pack.example_en: Lack of money is no barrier to learning if you are determined.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果你下定决心，缺钱不是学习的障碍。
vocab_pack.from_passage: age is no barrier to success

vocab_pack.definition_en: to follow or engage in what one strongly loves
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 pursuing 为动名词，作介词 about 的宾语，与 your passion 搭配，表示追求你的热爱。
vocab_pack.example_en: She decided to pursue her passion for music instead of studying law.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她决定追求对音乐的热爱，而不是学习法律。
vocab_pack.from_passage: pursuing your passion

vocab_pack.definition_en: to question or oppose unfair societal bias
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 challenging 为动名词，作介词 by 的宾语，表示通过挑战社会偏见来追求热爱。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many activists challenge social prejudice against minority groups.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多活动家挑战对少数群体的社会偏见。
vocab_pack.from_passage: challenging social prejudice against success at a young age

vocab_pack.definition_en: when someone is young
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 at a young age 为介词短语，作定语修饰 success，表示在年轻时就取得成功。
vocab_pack.example_en: He started learning English at a young age.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他从小就开始学英语。
vocab_pack.from_passage: at a young age

vocab_pack.definition_en: physical prizes or rewards of monetary value
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 material awards 为名词短语作宾语，与 winning 搭配，表示赢得任何物质奖励。
vocab_pack.example_en: He values spiritual satisfaction more than material awards.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他更重视精神满足而不是物质奖励。
vocab_pack.from_passage: winning any material awards

section_2_word_form.passage:
A 98-year-old house in Jing'an District, Shanghai, an exceptional example of cultural blending (融合), opened to the public on Saturday after it was moved to its new location.

The three-floor structure [56] in the 1920s as a residence by two well-known masters in painting, at 412 Weihai Road. After eight years of repair, it has been restored to [57] it originally looked like a century ago. Its unique mix of Chinese and Western architectural styles made it stand out in local historic garden houses, said Zhang Ming, an official in charge of the project.

[58] two towers with pinnacles (小尖顶) on top, it looks similar to [59] European castle on the southern side. The entrance is in ancient Greek style. The whole structure combines the architectural style of southern China on the northern side and the Middle-Age Europe. "We managed to obtain the original drawings, furniture, and items to restore [60] old look", said Zhang, CEO of Shanghai Zhangming Architectural Design Firm.

However, it was not easy to preserve the main structure which had been tested for a long time. "Our workers failed to keep the original layout and interior decorations," she said. "Luckily, we took efforts [61] similar materials and used various [62] skills to repair doors and windows."

Recently, the house, [63] Cha House, has opened to the public in honor of its founder Cha Chi Ming, who was a successful businessman in Shanghai. Cha House, a symbol of cultural blending, means a lot more to us than simply appealing [64] those who appreciate architecture. It also represents modern cities like Shanghai and their [65] and inclusiveness.

questions.explanation: 主语 The three-floor structure 与 build 构成被动关系，且时间状语 in the 1920s 表示过去，故使用一般过去时的被动语态。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was built)：语境句：The famous bridge was built over a hundred years ago. 固定搭配：build up, build a house。原词build其它变形：builder(n. 建筑者), building(n. 建筑物).

questions.explanation: 此处为介词 to 后面的宾语从句。从句 it originally looked like 中，介词 like 后面缺少宾语，因此用 what 引导该从句，意为“它最初的样子”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(what)：语境句：He finally realized what he had lost. 固定搭配：what matters most, what happened。

questions.explanation: 句中已有谓语 looks，此处用非谓语动词作状语。主语 it 与 feature（以……为特色）是主动关系，故填现在分词 Featuring。注意句首字母需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(Featuring)：语境句：Featuring a stunning sea view, the hotel is very popular among tourists. 固定搭配：feature film, distinctive feature。原词feature其它变形：featureless(adj. 无特色的).

questions.explanation: 此处泛指“一座欧洲城堡”，需填不定冠词。European 虽然首字母是元音字母，但发音以辅音 /j/ 开头，故使用 a 而非 an。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：He is studying at a European university. 固定搭配：a useful tool, a unique experience。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词短语 old look，需用形容词性物主代词。指代前文的 structure/house，故填 its。
questions.supplement: 正确形(its)：语境句：The dog wagged its tail when it saw its owner. 固定搭配：its origin, its own。原词it其它变形：itself(反身代词).

questions.explanation: take/make efforts to do sth 是固定搭配，意为“努力做某事”，此处需用动词不定式作后置定语或目的状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to find)：语境句：They took great efforts to find the missing child. 固定搭配：find out, find it difficult to do。原词find其它变形：finding(n. 发现, 多用复数), found(过去式/过去分词).

questions.explanation: 空后 skills 为名词，需用形容词进行修饰。convention 的形容词形式是 conventional，意为“传统的、常规的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(conventional)：语境句：They used conventional methods to solve the new problem. 固定搭配：conventional wisdom, conventional weapons。原词convention其它变形：unconventional(adj. 非传统的), conventionally(adv. 按照惯例).

questions.explanation: 句中已有谓语 has opened，此处需填非谓语动词作后置定语。the house 与 name（命名）之间是被动关系，故填过去分词 named，相当于 which is named。
questions.supplement: 正确形(named)：语境句：They visited a small town named after a famous poet. 固定搭配：name after, by name。原词name其它变形：namely(adv. 即, 也就是), nameless(adj. 无名的).

questions.explanation: appeal to sb 为固定搭配，意为“对某人有吸引力，引起某人的兴趣”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to)：语境句：The idea of living in the countryside doesn't appeal to me. 固定搭配：appeal to the public, lose its appeal。

questions.explanation: 位于物主代词 their 之后，且由 and 与名词 inclusiveness（包容性）并列，需填 open 的名词形式 openness，意为“开放（度）”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(openness)：语境句：The company was praised for its openness to new ideas. 固定搭配：with openness, openness to experience。原词open其它变形：opening(n. 缺口/开始), openly(adv. 公开地).

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely good, outstanding
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语，修饰名词 example，意为「杰出的」。形容词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: She made an exceptional contribution to the project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她对项目做出了杰出的贡献。
vocab_pack.from_passage: an exceptional example of cultural blending

vocab_pack.definition_en: accessible to everyone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 used as past tense verb phrase: 'opened to the public' 表示「向公众开放」的动作。固定搭配，一般用 be open to the public。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum is open to the public every Sunday.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆每周日向公众开放。
vocab_pack.from_passage: opened to the public on Saturday

vocab_pack.definition_en: to change location to (a place)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为被动语态 'was moved to'，moved 是过去分词，to 引出新地点，表示「被搬迁到」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company decided to move to a larger office.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 公司决定搬到更大的办公室。
vocab_pack.from_passage: after it was moved to its new location

vocab_pack.definition_en: the process of mixing or combining
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作名词，在短语 cultural blending 中作宾语，表示文化融合。
vocab_pack.example_en: The blending of different traditions creates a rich culture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 不同传统的融合创造了丰富的文化。
vocab_pack.from_passage: cultural blending (融合)

vocab_pack.definition_en: a house or place where someone lives
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作介词 as 的宾语，表示「作为住宅」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The president's official residence is in the capital.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 总统的官邸在首都。
vocab_pack.from_passage: built in the 1920s as a residence

vocab_pack.definition_en: to bring back to original condition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在完成时被动语态 'has been restored'，表示「已被修复」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Workers are restoring the ancient temple to its former glory.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 工人们正在修复古庙，使其恢复昔日的辉煌。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it has been restored to what it originally looked like

vocab_pack.definition_en: to resemble in appearance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去时 looked like，系动词 look 的过去式，like 为介词，后接从句 what it originally looked like。
vocab_pack.example_en: The clouds look like cotton candy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那些云看起来像棉花糖。
vocab_pack.from_passage: what it originally looked like a century ago

vocab_pack.definition_en: being the only one of its kind
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语，修饰 mix，意为「独特的混合」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Each person has a unique fingerprint.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每个人都有独特的指纹。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Its unique mix of Chinese and Western architectural styles

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be noticeable or prominent
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式短语，在 made it 后省略 to，表示「使它突出」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her red dress made her stand out in the crowd.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的红裙子使她在人群中很突出。
vocab_pack.from_passage: made it stand out in local historic garden houses

vocab_pack.definition_en: responsible for
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作后置定语，修饰 official，意为「负责该项目的官员」。介词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is in charge of the marketing department.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她负责市场部。
vocab_pack.from_passage: an official in charge of the project

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have as a distinctive characteristic
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词 Featuring 引导状语，表示「以两个尖顶塔楼为特色」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new smartphone features a high-resolution camera.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这款新智能手机以高分辨率摄像头为特色。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Featuring two towers with pinnacles on top

vocab_pack.definition_en: to resemble in appearance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时 looks similar to，looks 是系动词第三人称单数，similar to 是形容词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new building looks similar to the old one.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新建筑看起来与旧建筑相似。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it looks similar to a European castle on the southern side

vocab_pack.definition_en: to unite or merge
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时第三人称单数 combines，主语 The whole structure，意为「结合了…的风格」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The recipe combines traditional and modern ingredients.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个食谱结合了传统和现代的食材。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The whole structure combines the architectural style of southern China

vocab_pack.definition_en: relating to architecture
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语，修饰 style，意为「建筑风格」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The city is famous for its architectural heritage.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市以其建筑遗产闻名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the architectural style of southern China

vocab_pack.definition_en: to succeed in doing something difficult
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去时 managed to，后接不定式 obtain，表示「成功获得了」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He managed to finish the task on time despite the difficulties.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管有困难，他设法按时完成了任务。
vocab_pack.from_passage: We managed to obtain the original drawings

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get or acquire
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式，在 managed to 后，表示「获得」。
vocab_pack.example_en: You need to obtain a visa before traveling.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旅行前你需要获得签证。
vocab_pack.from_passage: We managed to obtain the original drawings

vocab_pack.definition_en: to keep in its original state
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式，在 it was not easy to preserve 中作主语补足语，意为「保存主结构」。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is important to preserve historical buildings.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 保护历史建筑很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it was not easy to preserve the main structure

vocab_pack.definition_en: to try or examine
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去完成时被动语态 had been tested，表示「被考验了很长时间」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new product was tested for safety.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新产品经过了安全测试。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which had been tested for a long time

vocab_pack.definition_en: to not succeed in doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去时 failed to，后接不定式 keep，表示「未能保留」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He failed to pass the exam despite studying hard.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管努力学习，他未能通过考试。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Our workers failed to keep the original layout

vocab_pack.definition_en: the way something is arranged
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作 keep 的宾语，与 original 搭配，意为「原始布局」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The layout of the garden is very beautiful.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 花园的布局非常美丽。
vocab_pack.from_passage: keep the original layout and interior decorations

vocab_pack.definition_en: traditional, customary
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语，修饰 skills，意为「传统技艺」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Conventional farming methods are being replaced by organic ones.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 传统农耕方法正在被有机方法取代。
vocab_pack.from_passage: used various conventional skills to repair doors and windows

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give a name to
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去分词 named 作后置定语，修饰 the house，意为「被命名为 Cha House」。
vocab_pack.example_en: They named their daughter after her grandmother.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们用祖母的名字给女儿命名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the house, named Cha House

vocab_pack.definition_en: as a sign of respect for
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作目的状语，表示「以纪念其创始人」。
vocab_pack.example_en: A ceremony was held in honor of the war heroes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 举行了一场仪式以纪念战争英雄。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has opened to the public in honor of its founder

vocab_pack.definition_en: a thing that represents something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作同位语，说明 Cha House 是文化融合的象征。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dove is a symbol of peace.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鸽子是和平的象征。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Cha House, a symbol of cultural blending

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be very important
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为 means a lot more，一般现在时第三人称单数，a lot more 是比较级，意为「意味着更多」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Your support means a lot to me.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你的支持对我来说意义重大。
vocab_pack.from_passage: means a lot more to us than simply appealing to those who appreciate architecture

vocab_pack.definition_en: to attract or interest
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词形式 appealing to，作介词 than 的宾语，表示「吸引那些欣赏建筑的人」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The idea of studying abroad appeals to many students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 出国留学的想法吸引了很多学生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: simply appealing to those who appreciate architecture

vocab_pack.definition_en: to recognize the value of; to enjoy
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中在定语从句中，who appreciate，动词原形，主语 who，意为「欣赏建筑的人」。
vocab_pack.example_en: I really appreciate your help.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我非常感激你的帮助。
vocab_pack.from_passage: those who appreciate architecture

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stand for, to be a symbol of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时第三人称单数 represents，主语 It，意为「代表现代城市」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dove represents peace.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鸽子代表和平。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It also represents modern cities like Shanghai

vocab_pack.definition_en: the quality of being open, not closed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作 represents 的宾语，与 inclusiveness 并列，意为「开放性和包容性」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The city's openness to new ideas attracts many entrepreneurs.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市对新思想的开放性吸引了许多企业家。
vocab_pack.from_passage: their openness and inclusiveness

vocab_pack.definition_en: the quality of including all people
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作 represents 的宾语，与 openness 并列，意为「包容性」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company promotes inclusiveness in the workplace.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 公司提倡工作场所的包容性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: their openness and inclusiveness
